calculation_handling.description: In Bicycle Zone 1, uses not covered by (1) and (5) need bicycle parking spaces equal to 15 percent of the parking spaces on the lot, rounded up, once 5 or more parking spaces are provided.
calculation_handling.gaps: Bicycle Zone map is not held; a percentage of a parking-space count rounded up cannot be written in the DSL (pct of units is not a permitted product).

units.disclosure: In Bicycle Zone 1, uses that the table and the dwelling-unit rule do not cover must provide bicycle parking spaces equal to 15 percent of the parking spaces on the lot, rounded up to the nearest whole number, when 5 or more parking spaces are provided. The Bicycle Zone map is not held, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: In Bicycle Zone 2, uses not covered by (1) and (5) need bicycle parking spaces equal to 10 percent of the parking spaces on the lot, rounded up, once 5 or more parking spaces are provided.
calculation_handling.gaps: Bicycle Zone map is not held; a percentage of a parking-space count rounded up cannot be written in the DSL (pct of units is not a permitted product).

units.disclosure: In Bicycle Zone 2, uses that the table and the dwelling-unit rule do not cover must provide bicycle parking spaces equal to 10 percent of the parking spaces on the lot, rounded up to the nearest whole number, when 5 or more parking spaces are provided. The Bicycle Zone map is not held, so this is not evaluated.

230.5.10.1(6).explanation: When working out bicycle parking for uses other than dwelling units, certain areas are not counted in the building's interior floor area: below-ground parking, loading and bicycle parking; required ground-level loading and above-ground bicycle parking; basement storage, washroom and utility rooms; required shower, change and bicycle maintenance facilities; elevator shafts; a mechanical penthouse; and exit stairwells.

230.5.10.1(7).explanation: Uses that the table and the dwelling-unit rule do not cover must still provide bicycle parking when 5 or more parking spaces are provided: 15 percent of the parking spaces on the lot in Bicycle Zone 1, or 10 percent in Bicycle Zone 2, rounded up. The zone is a map area that is not held, so this is not calculated here.
